'''Refain''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] adjudicator of the [[Department of Adjudication]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at the time of the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
Refain served as an adjudicator of the [[Department of Adjudication]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by the time of the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />

He led fellow adjudicators in the seizure of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]]' assets and the negotiations with [[Torkel Laphmer]], a senior Czerka executive with information on the classified moon facility, [[CZ-198]]. He would call for assistance from a Republic strike team to help in the [[Seizure of CZ-198]] due to Laphmer's information about the threats contained with the secret facility.<ref name="TOR" />

Around [[3627 BBY]], Refain oversaw the [[CI-004 Incident|operation]] of a strike team into the [[CI-004 Research Facility]], a Czerka complex on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]].<ref name="OP">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=operation|The Troubling Nature of Progress}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Refain is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2013]]. He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].<ref name="TOR" /> He appears again in the [[2019]] sixth expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']].<ref name="OP" />
